name: text-marker-sweep
title: Marker Highlight
description: Một dải bút dạ phủ 40 % dưới của dòng chữ kẻ dần từ trái sang phải trong 1.2 giây, nhiều dòng thì nối tiếp nhau.

moworks.author: takayu

options.duration: s (1.2), in-out, all lines as one stroke
options.band: em the band covers (0.42: the lower 40 %)
options.color: marker colour (#ffe46b; the demo an accent at 55 %)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-marker-highlight, written here): Band behind the text over the lower 40 % of the line (demo baseline − 0.3 em to + 0.12 em), marker colour (#ffe46b; demo accent at 55 %). Grows left → right (background-size 0 → 100 %), lines filled one after another as one stroke (box-decoration-break clone), 1.2 s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), delay 0.5 s; demo: small solid nib at the growing edge, slightly slanted ends. Text on top. Loop exit: band fades 2.55–2.85 s; loop 3 s. Params: duration (1.2 s) · delay (0.5 s) · band: độ cao dải (40 % dưới) · color: màu bút (vàng #ffe46b).
moworks.titleVi: Dải bút dạ kẻ dần sau chữ
